lines.en: My long hair drags at my heels.
Every step makes stones jump.
No eyebrows, so I look meaner.
My ki is so heavy I can only walk slowly.
This form drains ki fast.
The aura lifts my long hair.
Scorch marks follow my steps.
A crack trails along the ground.

lines.zh: 我抬脚很沉，落下去很炸
lines.en: My steps rise heavy and land like blasts.
My presence shoves the air aside.
This frame won't hold much longer.
My long hair swings like a tail.
Ki keeps leaking out; I can't stop it.
Even standing, I look like I'm roaring.
I count every breath.
This form is my last card.
Hair hanging down; I can't be bothered.
My throat's hoarse from shouting.
The ground slowly sinks under me.
Just a bit longer, just a bit.
Too much ki; even my face glows.

lines.zh: 没有眉毛，表情少了一半
lines.en: No eyebrows; half my expressions are gone.
This level frightens even me.
I keep still to conserve it.
The air hums under the pressure.

lines.zh: 要是能一直这样就好了
lines.en: If only I could stay like this.
You stand that far off because you're afraid.
This form rarely shows itself.
My ki presses on the ground.
Do you understand what I mean?

lines.zh: 再靠近一步，你就站不稳
lines.en: One step closer and you won't stand.
Same eyes, just looking at you.

lines.zh: 长发挡着，我照样看得清
lines.en: Hair in the way, I still see you.
Shouting costs ki; I'll speak little.
Your hands are shaking.

lines.zh: 我不需要摆姿势也很吓人
lines.en: I don't need a pose to be frightening.

lines.zh: 这一层次，不是给普通人看的
lines.en: This level isn't for ordinary eyes.
Still standing; that's brave.

lines.zh: 我呼吸一次，周围就震一下
lines.en: Each breath shakes the surroundings.
Don't stare too long.

lines.zh: 我身后那团气，会自己动
lines.en: The ki behind me moves on its own.
You look like you want to run.
Running won't help; I'm faster.

lines.zh: 我把话放这，别逼我动手
lines.en: I'll say it once: don't push me.
I lost a chunk of ki.
That shortened my time.
My long hair got knocked out of line.
I roared, but not from pain.
This form is wavering.
My ki is pulling back.

lines.zh: 你打中了我，但也只是打中
lines.en: You hit me, and that's all.
The ground sank another layer.
I need to save strength to finish this.
This form is hungrier.
I burn ki even eating.
That won't plug the drain.
Bring more; my appetite doubled.
I smell it; set it down.
Bending costs me a chunk of ki.
Not greed; I have to replenish.

lines.zh: 吃完这顿，我说不定就变回去
lines.en: After this meal I might revert.
Good timing, I'll give you that.
Hand it over; I won't walk for it.
You hit a wall of ki.
A bump doesn't move me.
You flew quite a distance.
My long hair caught you.
Move; I can't stop my feet.
I crushed the ground where I stood.
That bump should have numbed you.
I don't want to waste ki shoving you.
Steady; don't crowd me.
Even the wind follows me.
This form has no spare ki.
I have to steady myself first.

lines.zh: 你等的那个我，暂时不在
lines.en: The me you want isn't here right now.
This hair gets in the way.
If my ki wavers, I fall apart.
Talk to me after I revert.

lines.zh: 这力量不是用来温柔的
lines.en: This power isn't for gentleness.
I'm rationing ki even to speak.
Stand further back; be safe.

lines.zh: 时间不多，聊别的都浪费
lines.en: Time's short; anything else is waste.
Every bend costs a slice of ki.
One grab and it's up.
This doesn't merit a movement.
My hair hangs down and blocks the view.
Pick it up, tuck it in.
I'll keep what's on the ground.
A push of ki and it's mine.
Slow, but nothing slips by.

lines.zh: 我可不想为这个变回去
lines.en: I won't revert over this.
One bean might be my life.

lines.zh: 这形态一开，就别想善了
lines.en: Once this form opens, this won't end well.
My ki already covers you.
This roar is your last warning.
Speed and strength, all doubled.
Meteor combo, ready.
Even at the horizon it won't help.
I don't need to dodge.
My long hair bristles as one.
The ground starts to sink.
My ki cannon is gathered.
You've provoked the final level.
I'll be there in three seconds.
This is fusion's limit.

lines.zh: 别拿之前那两个形态衡量我
lines.en: Don't measure me by my earlier forms.
One roar, and the hills echo.
One stride crosses half the field.
My long hair streams behind me.
Ki blasts stream from my fingers.

lines.zh: 你听到的轰鸣是我的气
lines.en: That roar you hear is my ki.
I don't chase; I simply arrive.
The prelude to a meteor combo.

lines.zh: 你眨眼的时间够我打三下
lines.en: Your blink is time for three hits.
The ground crumbles under me.
I flank without turning.
My ki throws up all the dust.
You can't see me through the dust.
I don't hide in this form.
Every breath builds power.
Counting how much longer I last.
The aerial barrage has begun.
All you can do is block.
Stop trying to make distance.
I held back on this last one.
Meteor combo, raining down.

lines.zh: 一拳带出的气浪能掀人
lines.en: The shockwave from one punch lifts people.
Even my long hair is a weapon.
This blow collapsed the ground.

lines.zh: 连打十下，一下比一下重
lines.en: Ten hits, each heavier.
I drop straight from the sky.
My knee drives up.
A ki blade slices the air.
Aerial combo, third part.
Don't count; you can't keep up.
This kick shattered the stone.
Ki cannon, straight on.
My fist arrives before the sound.

lines.zh: 收尾这一下，给你留个印
lines.en: This finisher leaves a mark.
You blocked, and slid back five steps.
This is Super Saiyan 3.
One long roar, and everything shakes.
My hair stretches to full length in a flash.
Golden lightning circles me.
I open this form only once.
My ki shoved the clouds aside.

lines.zh: 站着的这块地已经在裂
lines.en: The ground beneath me is already cracking.
Super Saiyan 3 Gotenks appears.
An eyebrow-less face is harder to read.
All sound around grows muffled.
I land, and dust shoots skyward.

lines.zh: 这层力量，是拿时间换的
lines.en: This power is bought with time.
Stay back; this aura injures.
The fusion's last card.
I can feel every strand of hair.
The thunder hasn't stopped.
A long roar serves as my report.
This body is burning hot.
Watch; I'll demonstrate once.

lines.zh: 火焰被我的气逼开了些
lines.en: The flames were pushed back by my aura.
I hit the ground and made a crater.
My long hair soaked and dragged me down.
The blast only made me sway.
Something grazed past my long hair.
This energy is unfamiliar and stubborn.
My ki idles empty; I'm fading.

lines.zh: 雷和我身上的气撞在一起
lines.en: Lightning clashed with my aura.
Even this form is falling.
